scripts.build: bun run --filter './packages/*' build && bun run --filter './apps/*' build
scripts.ci: docker-compose up -d postgres && bun run format && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run check-types && bun run test
scripts.clean: sh -c '((command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker-compose down -v --remove-orphans) || (command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose down -v --remove-orphans) || true) && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist apps/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo coverage apps/*/coverage apps/api/.nest apps/api/node_modules/.cache apps/docs/.next apps/docs/.source apps/web/node_modules/.vite .turbo pgadmin /tmp/esbuild*'
scripts.docs:generate-api: bun run --filter './apps/api' openapi:generate && bun run --filter './apps/docs' openapi:generate
scripts.ls:
node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); console.log('
📋 Available Scripts:
'); Object.entries(pkg.scripts).forEach(([name, cmd]) => console.log('  ' + name.padEnd(25) + ' ' + cmd)); console.log('
💡 Usage: bun run <script-name>
');"
